answer.rationale: §1904.39(a)(2) requires reporting within 24 hours only for in-patient hospitalizations that result from a work-related incident. The scenario does not establish whether the illness was work-related or whether the hospital admission constituted formal in-patient treatment, both of which are material predicates for triggering the reporting obligation.
answer.missing_information_or_escalation_reason: Need confirmation that (1) the illness was work-related, and (2) the hospitalization qualifies as in-patient treatment (not just observation/treatment in an ER) under §1904.39.
